eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 44 · MySQL Backup & Recovery

code:
mysqldump -u root -p mydatabase > backup.sql

mysqldump -u root -p --all-databases > full_backup.sql

mysqldump -u root -p --databases db1 db2 > sel.sql
caption: --databases (plural) adds CREATE DATABASE statements.
Consistent InnoDB snapshot — no table locks, no blocked writers.

code:
mysql -u root -p < full_backup.sql

# no separate "restore" command —
# it's replaying the SQL file
caption: Restore time scales with data volume; every row re-inserts.

subtitle: The industry-standard tool for large MySQL databases.
